# cloudsmith_team (Resource)

The teams resource allows creation and management of teams within a Cloudsmith organization.

See [docs.cloudsmith.com](https://docs.cloudsmith.com/accounts-and-teams/teams) for full team documentation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "cloudsmith" {
  api_key = "my-api-key"
}

data "cloudsmith_organization" "my_org" {
  slug = "my-organization"
}

resource "cloudsmith_team" "my_team" {
  organization = data.cloudsmith_organization.my_org.slug_perm
  name         = "My Team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A descriptive name for the team.
- `organization` (String) Organization to which this team belongs.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the team's purpose.
- `slug` (String) The slug identifies the team in URIs.
- `visibility` (String) Controls if the team is visible or hidden from non-members.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `slug_perm` (String) The slug_perm immutably identifies the team. It will never change once a team has been created.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# ID format: <workspace_slug>.<team_slug>
import {
  to = cloudsmith_team.my_team
  id = "my-workspace.my-team"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# ID format: <workspace_slug>.<team_slug>
terraform import cloudsmith_team.my_team my-workspace.my-team
```
